Daniel Malhotra
daniel.malhotra@example.com | Boise, ID
Daniel Malhotra has 10 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Copperfield Digital (2024-2026), where
they built and maintained REST APIs in Redis serving 546K requests/day. Before
that, Senior Backend Engineer at Quartzline Platform (2023-2024). Before that,
Backend Engineer at Ashgrove Dynamics (2016-2023). Education: Ph.D. Electrical
Engineering, Cal Poly, 2016; B.S. Electrical Engineering, Penn State
University, 2010. Core skills: Kafka, gRPC, Redis, Distributed systems, Go,
Microservices, TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, CI/CD.
